label: sdc02_0085_sister_02
text: I heard the news! You got picked for Blueberry\nAcademy’s exchange program, right?[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc02_0085_sister_03
text: Hah! One of my teachers told me. Never thought\nwe’d be fellow students of BB Academy![VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc02_0085_sister_04
text: Nice try, but you can’t fool me! I’ve already got\nsolid confirmation you’ve been enrolled here![VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc02_0085_sister_05
text: Anyway, you should totally come show your face.\nIt’s been too long already![VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc02_0085_sister_06
text: Now, let me think... Where could we meet up?\nOh! Have you been to the Terarium?[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc02_0085_sister_07
text:
There’s a space called the Central Plaza right in
the center of the dome! I’ll meet you there!\c
Don’t keep me waiting if you know what’s good
for you![VAR 0x0114(0044)]
